subject: [RFC PATCH 17/18] mm/shmem: read without folio references

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch modifies the shmem_file_read_iter function to avoid taking a reference on every folio it reads, which can cause bouncing of the refcount when small reads are made from multiple CPUs. Instead, it uses filemap_read_rcu to copy data without acquiring a reference, and continues with the existing loop where necessary. This change also drops the folio lock and reference, making reads non-atomic against writes or hole punches. Additionally, it ensures that readahead is not triggered on shmem folios, which have their PG_readahead bit set as PG_reclaim.
